page: Microsoft Azure DC4eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the DCEDV6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The underlying virtualization is managed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing fast read and write capabilities directly on the host. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing users to attach high-performance external persistent disks. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC4eds_v6 offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and local high-speed solid-state storage without the overhead of a GPU. This hardware profile is suitable for memory-sensitive applications, database workloads, and general-purpose enterprise tasks that benefit from local NVMe storage and Intel-based virtualization.
